# goslop text fixture — Exception:break after await websocket.receive()
# (niquests test_asgi ws-echo disconnect FP)
lang: python
file: tests/test_asgi.py
---
@app.websocket("/ws-echo")
async def ws_echo(websocket):
    await websocket.accept()
    while True:
        try:
            data = await websocket.receive()
        except Exception:
            break
        if data["type"] == "websocket.disconnect":
            break
        if "text" in data:
            await websocket.send_text(f"echo: {data['text']}")
